title: Spring Boots
speaker: kenji
intro: The Spring Boots, Max-kun! Bounce power is spring strength times lever length. Too little and you flop; too much and you meet the ceiling. We want power between 20 and 30!
success: Yosh — perfect bounce! I'll wire every spring pad in Terra Nova to your new boots. Boing responsibly!
goalText: Pick a spring and a lever so strength × length lands between 20 and 30.
failText: Multiply the spring number by the lever number — is it between 20 and 30?
